title: Pride Shulker Box
description: Changed shulker box on pride flags
body:
# 🏳️‍🌈 Pride Flag Shulker Boxes

Turn your shulker boxes into a burst of pride!  

This resource pack is an ongoing project that aims to replace **all shulker box textures** (default + all 16 dyed colors) with beautiful and vibrant **Pride flags**. Now your storage can look as colorful and inclusive as it deserves to be! 

*Note: This pack is currently a Work in Progress (WIP). I am actively adding new flags, so check back for updates!*

### 🌟 Available Flags (Completed)
- 📦 **Default Shulker Box** → **Classic Rainbow Pride Flag** 
- ⬜ **White Shulker Box** → **Agender Flag** 
- ◻️ **Light Gray Shulker Box** → **Asexual Flag** 
- 🩶 **Gray Shulker Box** → **Aromantic Flag** 
- ⬛ **Black Shulker Box** → **Intersex Flag** 
- 🟫 **Brown Shulker Box** → **Bigender Flag** 
- 🟥 **Red Shulker Box** → **Lesbian Pride Flag** 
- 🟧 **Orange Shulker Box** → **Gay (Men) Pride Flag** 
- 🟨 **Yellow Shulker Box** → **Non-Binary Flag** 
- 🟩 **Lime Shulker Box** → **Genderqueer Flag** 
- 🟢 **Green Shulker Box** → **Genderfluid Flag** 
- <font color="#00AAAA">■</font> **Cyan Shulker Box** → **Pansexual Flag** 
- 🩵 **Light Blue Shulker Box** → **Transgender Flag** 
- 🟦 **Blue Shulker Box** → **Bisexual Flag** 
- 🟪 **Purple Shulker Box** → **Demigirl Flag** 
- 🌺 **Magenta Shulker Box** → **Polyamory Flag** 
- 🩷 **Pink Shulker Box** → **Sapphic Pride Flag**

---

### ✨ Features:
- 🔄 **Ongoing Updates:** Gradually replacing every shulker box texture.
- 🎨 **Unique Designs:** Once finished, every one of the 16 dyed colors + the default shulker box will get its own unique Pride flag.
- 👓 **Inventory Friendly:** Bright, high-contrast designs that stay readable in inventories and when placed in the world.
- 🤝 **Compatibility:** Works perfectly with vanilla shulker boxes and most other resource packs.
- ⚙️ **Version:** Supports Minecraft 1.21+

**Pride is about love, acceptance, and vibrant colors!** Carry your flag with you — even your storage is proud now 🌈

---

### 📥 Installation:  
Just drop the `.zip` file into your `resourcepacks` folder and enable it in the game settings.

*Want extra flags, different pairings, or sparkles on the textures? Leave a comment — I’ll happily update it!*
